extracted.description: NO RESOLUTION CHILI I stopped making resolutions years ago. Now, I just aim for a healthier diet, more exercise, which is kinda hard with my genetic ailments 😑. I plan to grow my own food, can and preserve what I’m able to eat, and sell the rest. #GlobalApron 2025 New Year Resolutions
ingredient_lines: 4 pounds ground beef, turkey, venison or chicken, your preference, I prefer beef and venison
1 can each(15oz) black beans, cannellini beans and red kidney beans, all drained
2 cans Rotel tomatoes, your choice of heat
instruction_lines: Brown the meat, drain. Add 1 Tbsp avocado oil to stock pot, toss in onion and cook until soft and tender, stir in meat.
Add the rest of the ingredients, cook 30 minutes. Taste, add salt if needed.
Divide into individual portions, freeze for a week’s worth of grab-and-go meals. Serve over rice or with just a cracker or two.
If there’s a lot of liquid leftover, add some macaroni to it, throw in some shredded cheddar cheese for another meal.
